subject: [COMPANY] <> Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've been following the ambitious work that [COMPANY] is working on for
lunar exploration  and recent Nasa award!

I lead GTM efforts for Physical AI at Encord. We work with companies across
robotics, AVs, drones, and other autonomous systems to help them manage the
scale and complexity of multi sensor data across the end to end training
lifecycle.

Many of the customers that we work with (Boston Dynamics, Woven by Toyota,
Zipline, Agility, Dyna, etc) partnered with us as the scale of complexity
started to break initial tooling: multi-camera sensor fusion, agent based
pre-labeling, edge-case mining across diverse environments, and HITL post
labeling. The teams we work with at that stage are usually either hitting
walls with in-house annotation infrastructure or spending engineering
cycles maintaining pipelines that need to be automated.

Wanted to briefly connect to get a better sense of your perception/autonomy
work at Lunar.

Free on Friday 10-2pm PT for a chat?

subject: NVIDIA GTC follow-up question
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw your Nvidia GTC talk and had one questions - as Caper Cart scales to
2,000+ locations, how are you thinking about scaling the annotation
infrastructure for your Shelf Intelligence and Caper Sensors raw data?

The layer between raw sensor inputs and the grocery world model output is
where annotation and curation becomes the critical bottleneck - it's why
teams turn to Encord from tools like Label Studio who cannot handle
multi-camera video and time series data well.

This is because we specialise in that exact area as the data infrastructure
platform purpose-built for CV and physical AI at scale - working with teams
at Boston Dynamics, Physical Intelligence and Woven by Toyota.

Would you be the right person to connect with at Caper, or is there someone
else you'd point me to?

text:

different camera setups, lighting, and edge cases.

that time back?

two questions we normally get asked are:
Can Encord be deployed fully on-premise?
Yes. The full platform runs inside your own infrastructure, including
air-gapped. No data touches Encord servers.

How does Encord handle export control (ITAR / EAR)?
The on-premise and VPC options are built for export-controlled
environments. Your data stays in your infrastructure with access controls
and audit logs, and we provide a security documentation package for your
legal and compliance teams to review.

If there's a relevant person on the imaging or machine learning side, I'd
value a short introduction. Happy to run a 20-minute session showing how
the Forterra workflow operates, no commitment expected.
